Name: Warp Editor
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b][size=6]Warp Editor
[/size][/b]
Tired of broken or incorrect warp points on your custom maps?
[b]Warp Editor[/b] lets you fix, test, and manage warps directly [i]in-game[/i] — no need to edit map files.


 [size=4]Features
[/size][list]
[*]Opens a [b]warp editor[/b] from a new button at the bottom-right of the map menu.
[*]Edit warps by selecting a starting point and adjusting its destination map and coordinates.
[*]Changes are saved in [b]config.json[/b], not the map file — perfect for testing or debugging your mods.
[*]Fully works in [b]multiplayer[/b], even for warps that normally only work for the main player.
[*]Compatible with [b]mine map retextures[/b] and other custom locations.
[/list]
[size=4] Recommended
[/size]
For best results, use this together with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31622]Ilucie’s Location Tracker[/url]﻿[/b]— it makes testing and navigating locations much easier.


[size=4] Notes[/size][list]
[*]Ideal for modders working with custom maps or warp-heavy locations.
[*]Safe to use: no permanent changes are made to your .tbin or .xnb maps.
[/list]
